welcome.title: Your creativity starts here
welcome.body: Pick a challenge, share your work and earn XP and rewards.
welcome.mediaAlt: CREATE / SHARE / EARN — MAKE IT YOURS.

roles.title: How will you join us?
roles.body: Choose the space that fits your goal.

signin.title: Welcome back!
signin.body: Sign in and continue your challenges.
signin.resetDone: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.body: Fill in your details and pick your interests.

errors.name: Enter your name.
errors.password: Password must be at least 8 characters.
errors.taken: An account with this email already exists.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.body: We will email you a reset link.
reset.sentBody: A reset link was sent to {email}.
reset.newBody: Enter a new password for your account.
reset.invalidLink: This link is invalid or expired. Request a new one.

terms.title: Terms & privacy
terms.body: Learn how we handle your content.
terms.reviewBody: Missions are checked against the rules.
terms.dataBody: You can change your choices at any time.

pending.title: Coming soon
pending.body: This screen is built in a later phase.

interests.title: What are you into?
interests.body: We use your interests to show challenges that suit you.

home.body: Discover challenges that match your interests.

discover.title: Find your challenge
discover.empty: No challenges for this selection yet

filters.title: Search & filter
filters.noChallenges: No challenges for this selection yet

rules.title: Campaign rules
rules.body: Final terms are set by the campaign organiser.

join.title: Before you start
join.body: Check the terms and start the mission.
join.ownBody: Only publish video you filmed yourself.
join.reviewBody: XP is added once your entry is approved.

qr.title: QR visit
qr.body: Fit the partner's QR code inside the frame.
qr.denied: No camera access. Enter the code manually.
qr.unsupported: The camera isn't available in this browser.
qr.okBody: QR check complete. Now post your video on your channel and register the post.
qr.failBody: Make sure the code belongs to the campaign's partner venue.

post.title: Register your post
post.body: Post your video on TikTok or Instagram, then pick the post or paste its link.
post.connectBody: TikTok or Instagram · pick a post
post.rulesBody: Add {tags}. The post must be public and yours.

errors.invalid: Paste a valid TikTok or Instagram post link.
errors.locked: This mission unlocks after the QR check-in.

post.checkingBody: We're checking the hashtag, publish date and account.
post.sentBody: We'll let you know when the brand reviews your post. The video stays on your channel.
post.fixTitle: Your post is missing a hashtag
post.fixBody: The caption is missing {tags}. Add the hashtag on your channel and check again.
post.doneBody: Your work was approved and {xp} XP was added to your account.
post.approvedBody: Your post was approved. Finish the remaining missions.

location.title: Choose a location
location.body: We'll show challenges for the city you pick.
